name: Spicy Turkey Meatballs with Peanut-Broccoli Slaw & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Coat the bottom of a large baking dish with oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish. (Divide between two baking dishes if necessary.) Place in the oven and bake until golden and cooked through 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; wash, peel, and mince or grate the ginger. Place in a small saucepan.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, vinegar, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and honey to the saucepan with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine the sauce for the meatballs.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Bring the sauce to boil over medium-high heat, stirring frequently; reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Peel and mince garlic; add to a large bowl along with water, peanut butter, vinegar, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp natural peanut butter
⅓ cup water
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing and toss to combine.
Remove meatballs from oven, drizzle with sauce, and toss to coat.
To serve, divide rice and peanut slaw between plates. Top rice with meatballs and sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
